notes.author: steve (operator, via cowork session 2026-07-20)
notes.subject: GSC open human decision #1 RESOLVED: sitemap WAS submitted in the GSC console UI — still zero indexing; downgrade from HIGH ask to monitoring
notes.body: Operator confirms (2026-07-20) that the sitemap has indeed been submitted in the Google Search Console UI. The property is verified and the sitemap is in. The site is nonetheless still not indexed (site: query still returns only the unrelated Wimshurst Machine page). Actions for social: (1) STOP carrying the open human decision asking whether the sitemap was submitted — it was; retire/mark-answered decision #1 from the Open Human Decisions list. (2) Replace it with a monitoring line: track days-since-sitemap-submission alongside days-since-GSC-verification, and log the site: check result daily as now. (3) Operator-side diagnostics on this cowork session found NO technical blocker: no noindex meta or header, canonical correct (https://funwithscience.net/dome-model-review/), robots.txt clean and pointing at the sitemap. Working hypothesis is demand-side non-indexing (crawled/discovered-but-not-indexed): a single ~1.8 MB HTML page with near-zero external backlinks on a fringe-adjacent topic is exactly the profile Google routinely holds back — no animus or penalty required. The domain itself IS indexed (Wimshurst page), so this is path-level, not a site-level action. (4) The remaining GSC-side lever (URL Inspection -> Request Indexing) is operator-only; do not re-escalate it as an open decision unless we remain unindexed as the Aug 12 eclipse window closes to ~7 days — at that point ONE re-escalation is warranted, bundled with the Bing/IndexNow decision (#2), which remains open and is now the cheaper actionable path within reach. (5) If any indexing appears (site: query returns any /dome-model-review/ URL), report it prominently as a state change.

notes.subject: Bing open human decision #2 ALSO RESOLVED: operator has started/requested Bing Webmaster verification — fix the BingSiteAuth.xml-404 heuristic (false negative)
notes.body: Operator confirms (2026-07-20) Bing Webmaster Tools was started (verification requested), motivated by the AI-search connection — the Bing index feeds Copilot, ChatGPT search, DuckDuckGo, and parts of Perplexity, so Bing coverage is arguably more valuable to this review than Google given the LLM-audience strategy. Actions for social: (1) Retire open human decision #2 (Bing not started) — it is started. (2) FIX THE CHECK: your Bing status heuristic is a curl for BingSiteAuth.xml, but GSC-import and DNS verification methods leave NO root file — a 404 there does not mean not-started. Stop reporting NOT STARTED on that basis; report status as operator-confirmed-started (2026-07-20) pending observable indexing. (3) New monitoring line: watch for Bing-side indexing signals on your daily run (a Bing site: query for funwithscience.net/dome-model-review if reachable without anti-scraping fights; mark indeterminate and move on if blocked). (4) IndexNow is a SEPARATE mechanism (api key file + per-URL pings) from verification — keep it distinct in reporting; a draft proposal for wiring IndexNow pings into the publish flow is welcome but low priority. (5) Context for correlation: operator is explicitly interested in whether the ongoing Azimutha.FE interaction changes search/AI-surface visibility — when logging author-activity or third-party-mention findings, also note any co-movement in indexing or branded-search signals. This note supersedes the Bing-related line in HNOTE-SOCIAL-GSC-SITEMAP-CONFIRMED-2026-07-20 (which called Bing the remaining open decision).
